templates.name: Release Checklist
templates.description: Final release day checklist for music distribution
templates.content:
# Release Checklist

## Release
<!-- Title and date -->

## Pre-Release (T-4 weeks)
- [ ] Distributor upload complete
- [ ] Metadata verified on all platforms
- [ ] Cover art uploaded (3000x3000 min)
- [ ] Pre-save links generated

## Release Week
- [ ] Social media posts scheduled
- [ ] Music video / visualizer ready
- [ ] Press release sent
- [ ] Playlist curators contacted

## Release Day
- [ ] Verify live on all platforms
- [ ] Share links on all channels
- [ ] Smart link active (Linkfire / ToneDen)
- [ ] Monitor for issues

## Post-Release
- [ ] First week numbers reviewed
- [ ] Playlist placements tracked
- [ ] Press coverage collected
